title: Software Developer – AI and Automation
description: About the roleThis is a full-time role that can be based in either Melbourne or Brisbane.Our Development Teams are responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance and optimisation of Infoxchange's customer-facing and internal products – the software that powers services like Ask Izzy and our national service directory and helps people across Australia access vital support.The Software Developer – AI and Automation designs and delivers the automation that connects Infoxchange's business systems, and establishes the platform and standards that allow others across the organisation to build on it safely. The initial focus of the role is to establish our n8n automation platform and deliver its first production integration, between Jira and NetSuite. The role will then develop the guidelines and patterns that govern how n8n is used across the business, including environment management, secrets handling, authentication and access control.Subsequent work will focus on AI: integrating large language models into our systems, developing agent-based business automation, and leading practical AI experimentation with teams across the organisation. The role requires experience working with LLMs (using them to write code and run agentic workflows) and on LLMs (building agents and incorporating models into automation), applied with a software engineering discipline.This role is suited to candidates early in their software development career, or with a background in DevOps, systems or integration work. Candidates should have a sound understanding of the requirements of live production services – security, monitoring, recoverability and maintainability – and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly and deliver to a high standard.We are an AI-first development team. We expect our developers to work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot's agents – directing them effectively, providing the right context, and applying sound judgement to review and validate their output. AI accelerates our work; it does not replace the developer's responsibility for the result.This role brings together:hands-on delivery with a strong understanding of production operationsefficient delivery with the standard of security and data handling our clients rely onestablishing automation tools and guidelines that enable others in the business to build to a reasonable standard and follow best practiceAI experimentation with sound judgement about where it adds valueWe work in inclusive teams using lightweight agile processes. We use Git and automated CI/CD pipelines to collaborate, review each other's work and deliver to multiple environments, and we believe in automation over repetition. Above all, we have a passion for building high-quality products within an empowering culture and making a positive contribution to society through technology.What you'll doSet up and run our n8n platform, including hosting, environments (development, test and production), upgrades, backups and monitoring.Design, build and support the first production integration between Jira and NetSuite, including data mapping, error handling, retries, logging and alerting when something fails.Write and maintain the guidelines for how Infoxchange uses n8n: when to use it, how to structure and name workflows, how configuration and environment variables are managed, how secrets and credentials are stored and rotated, how authentication to other systems works, and how access is separated and inherited between teams and projects.Build reusable patterns, templates and shared components that enable staff to create their own automations safely, and review automations built by others.Integrate large language models into our systems and business processes, choosing sensible models and approaches for each job and keeping cost, reliability and data handling in view.Build agents and agentic workflows that automate real business tasks, with clear limits on what they can access and do, and a human in the loop where it matters.Lead practical AI experimentation with teams across the business: test ideas quickly, measure their value, and develop successful experiments into supported tools.Use AI development tools (such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot) fluently and responsibly, and help improve the context they work from – agent instructions, documentation, skills and internal tooling such as MCP servers.Apply and help enforce clear boundaries on AI use, particularly around client data, credentials and third-party services.Handle sensitive information with care, applying the privacy, security and auditability requirements that come with our clients' data.Follow good engineering practice: version control (Git), code review, automated testing and CI/CD, including for automations and workflows.Document solutions so that others can support and extend them.Collaborate with product, finance, operations and technical teams to understand their processes and identify where automation will deliver the most value.Uphold and advocate for the values, beliefs and principles outlined in the Technical Services Team Manifesto.QualificationsProfessional experience in software development, DevOps, systems administration, integration or a similar technical role. Candidates early in their career are encouraged to apply.A working understanding of what production systems need: security, monitoring, logging, backups, access control and safe change.Experience writing code in at least one language (for example JavaScript/TypeScript or Python), and working with REST APIs, webhooks and JSON.Practical experience using LLMs to write code and run agentic workflows (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar tools).Some experience building with LLMs: calling model APIs, building an agent or tool-using workflow, or using a model as a step in an automation.A working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they fail – context limits, non-determinism, confident-but-wrong output, prompt injection and data-handling risk – and how that shapes safe use.A sound understanding of security practice across systems and integrations, including secrets and credential management, authentication and authorisation (such as OAuth and API keys), least-privilege access, data protection, and secure configuration.Familiarity with Git and basic CI/CD.Clear written communication, including the ability to write guidance that non-developers can follow.Desirable:Experience with n8n, Zapier, Make, Power Automate or a similar workflow automation tool.Experience with the Jira or NetSuite APIs.Experience with Docker and cloud-hosted services (AWS or equivalent).Experience with MCP servers, retrieval (RAG) or evaluating LLM output.You can use this link to apply - https://ats.rippling.com/infoxchange/jobs/342656e5-d068-45c2-982f-ee986290ee76?st=c21336ae-1ed7-4885-9071-e207f2d2d460We are a proud equal opportunity employer committed to providing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment where all our team members feel like they belong. We know diversity makes us stronger and we encourage applications irrespective of background, age, origin, gender, sexual orientation, identity, or ability.If you feel comfortable, please let us know if you have any accessibility requirements upon application, so we can make any adjustments required to support you throughout our recruitment process. title: Applied AI Engineer
description: We're hiring an Applied AI Engineer to join our engineering team. You'll help turn licensed data into AI-ready data, working on processing, quality, and enrichment at scale. It's a hands-on role where you'll work closely with our CPTO and fellow engineers.Redpine is the knowledge layer for agentic AI, unlocking access to licensed premium, non-public data in health, science, finance, and physical AI. We work with some of the world's largest AI companies, and we've raised $9.4M from VCs and founders and leaders at OpenAI, Perplexity, Spotify, Sana, and SiloAI.What You'll DoBuild and ship AI features end to end, from first prototype to productionDevelop pipelines that ingest, process, and structure licensed content from our data partnersApply LLMs and agents to data quality, validation, and enrichment across text, images, and other formatsBuild the evals that tell us when output is right, and catch it when it stops being rightWork with product and commercial to turn real customer use cases into what we build nextWho You Are3+ years building and shipping production software, not prototypes someone else has to finishStrong Python and backend fundamentals, with experience running large-scale data pipelines in the cloudReal depth with LLM systems: agents, retrieval, tool use, and evals. You know where they break, and when a simpler approach does the job betterAI-native: coding agents do most of your typing. You know how to brief them, check their work, and stand behind what shipsOwnership by default. You take a broad goal, work out what it requires, and say so when the spec is wrongA track record of high ambition and figuring things out, with a bias for actionWhy RedpineAccess to quality data is one of the biggest bottlenecks in advancing AI where it matters most, from drug discovery to robotics. The company that builds the licensed layer underneath will define the next decade. Redpine will be that company. Joining now means ownership and impact from day one, working alongside a diverse core team from McKinsey, VC, Spotify, Sana, Zettle, Deloitte and more.The pace is high and so is the bar. We offer competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits. We're English-first and office-first in a beautiful space in central Stockholm. We hire for talent, drive, and attitude over a perfect CV. If this excites you, apply. Show more Show less
